primary_anchor_zh: 清楚分开的两只大型圆木凳
story_reason_zh: 木凳被取去擦拭，随后放回音乐室

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 一组大型木鼓凳在安静音乐室的木地板上，圆形凳面接收柔和窗光。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 圆形凳面接收柔和窗光
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 清楚分开的两只大型圆木凳占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 工作人员缓慢推动装有两只木凳的低车离开音乐室；随后呈现空木地板和后方吸音墙。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 工作人员缓慢推动装有两只木凳的低车离开音乐室
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 空木地板和后方吸音墙

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 工作人员缓慢将并排放着两只木凳的低车推回木地板
shot_design.main_action_zh: 工作人员缓慢将并排放着两只木凳的低车推回木地板
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 清楚呈现清楚分开的两只大型圆木凳；不要求复现精确排列。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames two large round wooden stools, clearly separated from each other on the floor of a quiet music room. Soft window light rests across their round seats.

A fixed wide shot shows two large round wooden stools, clearly separated from each other on the floor of a quiet music room. An assistant slowly pushes a low wheeled platform carrying both wooden stools through the music-room doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty wooden floor and the acoustic wall behind it. A sheer curtain moves gently.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty wooden floor and the acoustic wall behind it. An assistant slowly pushes a low wheeled platform carrying two large wooden stools side by side back into frame and stops it on the wooden floor.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 工作人员缓慢推动装有两只木凳的低车离开音乐室
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 空木地板和后方吸音墙
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 工作人员缓慢将并排放着两只木凳的低车推回木地板
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
